raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
**Stacked on #31843 → #31483** (review on top of those; diff collapses as they merge).

## What

Enable 2 more nested `unit/` files on AMD via an environment-capability skip, and harden one flat test against a missing optional dep.

| File | Change |
|---|---|
| `unit/sana_wm/test_pipeline_config.py` (5 tests) | `skipif` when torch lacks LAPACK — `torch.linalg.inv` in the camera-pose path. Runs on **ROCm 7.2.0 + CUDA**; skips on the ROCm 7.0.0 image. |
| `unit/sana_wm/test_realtime_chain.py` (1 test) | same LAPACK skip |
| `unit/test_pi05_action_api.py` (1 test, flat) | `skipif` when `msgpack` is unavailable (absent in the rocm720 image; present on CUDA / ROCm 7.0.0). Fixes a **pre-existing** rocm720 red, unrelated to the nested work. |

The 2 nested files are added to `_AMD_READY_NESTED_UNIT_TESTS` + `_MM_GEN_FILE_BACKENDS`. The flat msgpack file already runs via the flat glob (no allowlist change).

## Test plan

- [ ] `multimodal-gen-unit-test-amd` (ROCm 7.0.0) green
- [ ] `multimodal-gen-unit-test-amd-rocm720` (ROCm 7.2.0) green

> [!WARNING]
> You have reached your daily quota limit. Please wait up to 24 hours and I will start processing your requests again!

### Enable 2 nested unit files on AMD behind env-dependency skips

Now that #31483 and #31843 have merged, this is a standalone PR: **1 commit, 5 files, +59/-0**.

| Change | Why |
|---|---|
| `sana_wm/test_pipeline_config.py` (5 tests), `sana_wm/test_realtime_chain.py` (1 test) | skip when torch lacks LAPACK — the camera-pose tests call `torch.linalg.inv` |
| `test_pi05_action_api.py::test_msgpack_roundtrip...` | skip when the optional `msgpack` dependency is absent |
| `gpu_cases.py` + `ci_coverage_report.py` | add the 2 nested files to the AMD allowlist / coverage classifier |

AMD-only: `_discover_unit_tests()` returns just the flat `unit/test_*.py` glob unless `current_platform.is_hip()`, so the CUDA lane never collects these nested files and stays byte-identical. No production code is touched.

### Test: green on the integrated AMD pipeline

[`multimodal-gen-unit-test-amd`](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/31291458287/job/93189291976) — **success**:

```
= 1302 passed, 10 skipped, 5 deselected, 11 warnings, 91 subtests passed in 108.56s (0:01:48) =
```

Zero failures, with all **14 nested files** collected and executed. This ran on `027a5d6b48e2`; the current head `27705da86304` is the same content rebased after #31843 merged (that commit is now upstream), so the PR's own diff is unchanged.

The skip guards behave exactly as intended on ROCm 7.0 — the six LAPACK-guarded camera-pose tests skip, while `test_msgpack_roundtrip...` runs and passes because the image provides `msgpack`. On ROCm 7.2 the split inverts: the LAPACK tests run and the msgpack test skips. Each guard is inert on the lane that has the dependency, so neither can mask a real failure. The remaining skips (`test_streaming_cached.py` ×2, `test_saves_memory_and_reconstructs`, `test_integration_with_moto`) are pre-existing and unrelated.

Coverage classifier verified by running `scripts/ci/utils/ci_coverage_report.py` on this head: exactly 14 nested files credited to AMD, with the three deferred to #31846 correctly left CUDA-tagged.

<details>
<summary>Unrelated red checks</summary>

- `multimodal-gen-test-{1,2}-gpu-amd` — `Error: total_partitions (3) must be >= standalone files (7)`. A main-side config gap: `STANDALONE_FILES["2-gpu"]` grew to 7 entries without the workflow matrix being bumped. This PR does not touch `STANDALONE_FILES`.
- `PR Test (NPU)` — self-hosted runner container fault (`Executing the custom container implementation failed`). Unreachable from this PR, which is HIP-gated.
- Main-gate `base-b` failures — one root test failure with the remainder cascading via `check-pr-test-health`.
- `PR Test Extra` / `PR Test Extra (AMD)` — gated on the `run-ci-extra` label.

</details>
